block_id: <TradeBlocks block id holding every run of this triage>

author.label: <Strategy label of the author run in the block>

author_base.label: <Strategy label of the author_base run in the block (only when the run request lists it)>

naive.label: <Strategy label of the naive run in the block>

cost_2x.label: <Strategy label of the cost_2x run in the block>

_notes: Written into the run folder by the agent after importing the captured runs into one block (references/runs.md); never by hand. One entry per role that ran (author always; author_base only when the run request lists it); each label equals the run's label in run-request.json and its Strategy label in the block; every run has its capture id. The verdict script reads this file.
